item.title: Garamendi declares candidacy for re-election
item.description: On Friday Congressman John Garamendi (D-CA) filed papers declaring his candidacy for re-election to Congress in California’s 8th Congressional District. Garamendi has represented the region in Congress since 2009. Before that Garamendi served in the California Assembly and Senate, twice as California’s elected Insurance Commissioner, as Deputy Secretary of the U.S. Department of the Interior […]

item.title: Words of Wonder Bookstore opens in Vacaville library
item.description: Words of Wonder is ran by volunteers and managed by Friends of the Vacaville Libraries. Donations include used books, records, tapes, videos, CDs, and DVDs in “gently used” conditions and can be brought during business hours.
